study type: Cross-sectional (human placental tissue) and In vitro (trophoblast cells)
cohort: Placental tissues were obtained from pregnancies with preeclampsia and control pregnancies, and trophoblast cells were used for in vitro experiments.
finding: Elevated eccDNA levels in preeclampsia activate the STING pathway, driving inflammation and ferroptosis, which contributes to trophoblast dysfunction.
